Class ModelLessons

java.lang.Object
guiLessons.ModelLessons
public class ModelLessons extends Object

Title: ModelLessons Class.

Description: The Lessons Learned page Model. Unlike most of the stub Model classes elsewhere in this Foundations application, this page genuinely has data to track between user actions: which set of lessons is currently being displayed (either every lesson, from every contributor, or the subset returned by the most recent keyword or category search), and which specific lesson, if any, is currently selected for viewing, updating, or deleting.

Copyright: Ojas Patil © 2026

Version:
1.00 2026-10-23 Initial version for TP2 — added so the guiLessons package follows the same Model/View/Controller structure as the rest of the Foundations GUI packages. This page state previously lived directly in ControllerLessons; it has been moved here to align with the MVC pattern used throughout the provided Foundations code.

  • Field Details

    • currentList

      protected static entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList currentList
      The set of lessons currently being shown in the list widget. This is either every lesson in the system (after "Show All") or the subset matching the most recent keyword or category search. It may legitimately be empty.

    • selectedLessonId

      protected static int selectedLessonId
      The id of the lesson currently selected in the list, for viewing, updating, or deleting; -1 means no lesson is currently selected (i.e., the form is set up to create a new one).

    • selectedLessonAuthor

      protected static String selectedLessonAuthor
      The username of the author of the currently selected lesson, if any; null when no lesson is selected. Lets the page show who wrote the selected lesson.
